name: penname-macos
description: Penname for macOS — native shell (Tauri) around the Penname web app

scripts.sync: rm -rf webapp && mkdir -p webapp/icons && cp ../ios/index.html ../ios/style.css ../ios/app.js ../ios/gazetteer.js ../ios/engine.js ../ios/activity.js ../ios/manifest.webmanifest webapp/ && cp ../ios/icons/apple-touch-icon.png ../ios/icons/icon-192.png ../ios/icons/icon-512.png ../ios/icons/philanthropel-logo.png webapp/icons/ && cp -r ../ios/fonts webapp/fonts && echo 'webapp synced from ../ios'
